subject.title: refactor(plugin-sdk): consolidate persistent dedupe claim loop

question: Should `runClaimableDedupeClaimLoop` become a permanent public `openclaw/plugin-sdk/persistent-dedupe` API rather than remain an implementation detail for the currently bundled callers?
rationale: The patch deliberately increases the public plugin SDK callable surface, which creates an external compatibility commitment that tests and generated baselines cannot decide.

options.title: Accept the SDK helper
options.body: Approve the helper as a supported persistent-dedupe contract, with focused API behavior coverage and real dispatch proof before merge.

options.title: Keep it non-public
options.body: Rework the sharing boundary so bundled callers do not require a new external plugin SDK callable if maintainers do not want this contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the SDK helper
recommendation.body: Approve the helper as a supported persistent-dedupe contract, with focused API behavior coverage and real dispatch proof before merge.
